title: not thought out
text: not thought out. I got excited to make my eclair life a little easier and have nice small mini forms and an easy way to fill it. The baking form is somewhat ok, but the pocket with filling tips is useless. They claim you can use this to fill the dough neatly into the forms, but without a screwing mechanism to close, the silicone is supposed to magically stay in place when you press the pouch to fill the forms. Of course it does NOT and the whole dough pressed out on all sides and made a huge mess on my counter top. I can't imagine this working any better with pastry cream. I could see this working with hard plastic and screw top, but not with soft silicone and a soft cap!? Whoever though that this was a fab idea can come and clean my kitchen and whip up a new batch of dough (its hard enough to make). Just sell the form only and lower the price.
